headline: Frankie's Monday morning, Day 212 — and the honest headline is that launch day came and went. Aug 9 was the T-0 go/no-go; ~30 hours on there is still no evidence the $600 ever fired — not one Meta or Facebook message in the box (no ad-review decision, no billing receipt, no leads), state frozen since Aug 2, no cofounder sweep since Aug 6, and the Aug 10 AM brief never ran (this is the first brief in ~30h). That leaves two failure states and both point the same way: either the launch slipped because the gates never closed, or it went out blind — the exact outcome Vercel Analytics + the Meta MCP existed to prevent. Nothing about the plan changed, only the date slipped: the same four gates — Analytics ON, Meta MCP connected, NPN + CA-licence + not-guaranteed disclaimer on every creative and the landing page, and Frankie's still-unrecorded video kit — are the only things between $0 and a measurable launch. Correction to yesterday: the 'Chitraksh to VC USA' auto-connect phantom did NOT stay quiet — it fired again Aug 9 16:07Z, after that brief shipped, and is still the newest thing in the mailbox; decide it OFF before any cookie repair (W14). So today's job isn't another go/no-go — it's to close the two or three open gates and actually launch, or record the decision to hold to a named date. The worst outcome is the one that just happened: a launch date passing with no call made.

spotlight.title: The launch didn't fire — and the pre-spend gate is exactly why (Analytics + Meta MCP)
spotlight.detail: This stopped being prep — it's the post-mortem on a slipped launch and the unlock for the next attempt. Vercel Analytics is still unconfirmed, so Frankie's question ('is anyone visiting the site?') stays unanswerable and any paid traffic is unmeasurable; the Meta MCP is still unattached, so creatives can't be pushed or monitored programmatically and the $600 has to be driven by hand. These two are why Aug 9 could not be a clean launch — close both today and the next launch is real, not blind. The free Analytics tier answers the question with no overspend. Build discipline still binds once it goes: never raise budget >20-25% inside 3-4 days (Andromeda relearns), refresh creatives ~every 15 days.

spotlight.title: Frankie's video kit is now the critical path — no footage, no compliant creative

Until it lands there is nothing compliant to launch with. The same five minutes gate the whole run alongside it — your NPN, your CA producer-licence #, and a not-guaranteed / rates-vary disclaimer on every creative AND the landing page; the old account was banned for the absence of exactly those. Shirt + tie, iPhone at 4K/60fps, ~20-24 min of takes, then hand the footage to Chitraksh.

spotlight.title: Make the call today — launch for real, or record the hold

If it can't all close, decide out loud that the launch is held to a NAMED date and write it down — a recorded pause is a decision; a silently-slipped launch is the exact failure mode Meeting 38's '3 tasks per 15 hours' was built to kill.
